# Tomas Ameri — Digital Product Builder & Systems Engineer

> Tomas Ameri is a systems student and digital product builder based in Buenos Aires, Argentina. He specializes in marketplace architecture, applied artificial intelligence, and end-to-end process automation. Founder/contributor at CreatorPlace.

## Core Expertise & Topical Authority
- **Applied Artificial Intelligence**: Semantic search, vector embeddings (Gemini/OpenAI), LLM integration, and neural concept graphs for web apps.
- **Marketplace & Platform Engineering**: Multi-tenant architectures, payment/escrow flows, low-friction UX, and scalable databases with Appwrite and PostgreSQL.
- **Modern Full-Stack Engineering**: Next.js (App Router, Server Actions, ISR/SSR), React 19, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Appwrite Backend.
- **Product Philosophy**: "Build. Validate. Refine." Reducing friction, simplifying workflows, and connecting people efficiently.

## Key Projects & Case Studies
- **CreatorPlace**: Digital platform and marketplace connecting creators, products, and automated workflows.
- **Neural Blog & Knowledge Graph**: Technical journal powered by Next.js, Appwrite, and Gemini Embeddings with interactive force-directed graph visualization of concepts.
- **Marketplace Platforms**: Scalable, frictionless multi-vendor systems and digital workflow automations.

## Writing & Technical Focus
- Applied AI workflows and neural concept mapping.
- Architecture patterns for modern Next.js + Appwrite applications.
- Reducing user friction and cognitive load in web interfaces.
